provenance.instrument: Official Zoning Ordinance of the Township of Canton (Chapter 27 Zoning, Ord. No. 4-2022 of 6-9-2022), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 CA2579, Township of Canton (27-501.2(3): 'Areas contained within Canton Township have been identified as being within the "airport hazard area" for the Washington County Airport, located in Washington County'). The Land Use Table (27-304.1) and the district area and bulk tables (27-401.1) are text. Floodplain rules are in Chapter 8. New Laws: none on zoning
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 table of contents: 'Includes legislation through 05-08-2025.' New Laws lists Ord. No. 4-2025, 2-2026, 5-2026, 6-2026 and resolutions, none on Chapter 27
checks: The code has no accessory dwelling unit. The words searched (accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, garage apartment, ECHO, elder cottage, second dwelling, living quarters, caretaker, conversion, temporary dwelling, extended family) find only the single-family conversion use (27-203, 27-2301.1.8, 27-304.1), conversion rows in the area and bulk tables (27-401.1) and unrelated uses

Single-family conversion: 'A change in residential use form one single-family dwelling to two or three dwelling units in the same building' (27-203). The Land Use Table marks it P (permitted) in A-1, R-1, R-2 and R-3 (27-304.1, row 8). It needs at most three units in the building, two means of egress from each floor, one parking space on the lot for each apartment unit, no front-yard parking except in a driveway, and Township review of the floor plans under the building code (27-2301.1.8)

The district area and bulk tables list 'Conversion apartment' in R-1 and 'Conversion apartments' in R-2 among the conditional uses, and 'Multifamily conversion' among the permitted uses in R-3 (27-401.1(2)B, (3)B, (4)A). They give no figures of their own ('#: Standards for principal use apply'). Where the language is in doubt the code says it 'shall be interpreted ... in favor of the property owner' (27-105). Ask the zoning officer whether a conversion in R-1 or R-2 is by right or a conditional use before the Board of Supervisors
No district lists a second dwelling on a house lot. A new detached unit is not a listed use, so it is a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board (27-2807.9). No bar on a use variance was found

The area and bulk tables list 'Duplex housing' as permitted in R-2 (32,000 sq ft) and R-3 (12,000 sq ft), while the Land Use Table lists single-family semidetached and attached dwellings, not duplexes (27-401.1(3)A, (4)A, 27-304.1)

On-lot sewage: 'Minimum lot area for new uses, utilizing individual lot sewage disposal systems in any zoning district shall be two acres in area and the maximum residential density for any dwelling unit shall be one dwelling unit per two net developable acres' (27-305(2)). Where public water or sewer is at or near the lot, the owner must connect (27-501.2(4)B)

A-1 and R-1 single-family lots: '0' acres, 120 ft wide, side 20 ft, rear 30 ft, height 35 ft. The R-1 front yard is 40 ft on a local street, 50 ft on a collector and 60 ft on an arterial street (27-401.1(1)A, (2)A)

Sensitive environmental areas 'shall not be physically disturbed or used for any use other than agricultural uses, natural conservation areas' and conservation: natural slopes over 25%, wetlands, and quarries, streams, lakes, dams or ponds and all areas within 50 ft of them (27-501.2(1))

Floodplain (Chapter 8): a permit is needed for any construction or development in the township (8-202, 8-302). 'Within any identified floodplain area, any new construction shall be prohibited' unless the Township grants a variance, and then basements are prohibited and the lowest floor must be at or above the regulatory flood elevation (8-502(1), C(1), 8-801). An accessory structure there 'shall not be designed or used for human habitation' (8-502(1)E). Fill and manufactured homes are prohibited with no variance (8-503(1)A, 8-506). Work of 50% or more of market value on an existing structure is a substantial improvement (8-702)
A nonconforming use may be expanded by 25% or less of its floor or land area (27-2402). No relief for a small lot of record was found in the parts read

Accessory structures are permitted in every district (27-304.1, row 83) and 'must be owned by the same person(s) as the property owner' (27-203). No accessory building yards or height were found in the parts read
Conditional uses go to the Board of Supervisors after Planning Committee review and a public hearing (27-2808.1). Variances: 27-2807.9
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Canton Township Zoning Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360 (print view), one page at a time, on 2026-11-17. Read: 27-105, 27-203, 27-304.1, 27-305, 27-401.1, Part 5, Part 8, 27-2301.1.8, Part 24, 27-2807.9, 27-2808.1, Chapter 8 from 8-101 to the start of 8-902, and code searches. Not read: 27-101 to 27-104, 27-106, 27-201, 27-202, 27-301 to 27-304, 27-401, 27-402, Parts 6, 7 and 9 to 22, Part 23 except 27-2301.1.8, Parts 25 to 27, Part 28 except 27-2807.9 and 27-2808.1 (so 27-2809 and 27-2809.1 on special exceptions were not read), and the rest of the Chapter 8 definitions. Open points: whether a single-family conversion in R-1 and R-2 is by right (27-304.1) or a conditional use (27-401.1), what the '0' acre minimum for a single-family lot in A-1 and R-1 means, and whether lot coverage counts only buildings.

value.condition: Sensitive environmental areas may not be physically disturbed or used except for agriculture and conservation: natural slopes over 25%, wetlands, and quarries, streams, lakes, dams or ponds and all areas within 50 ft of them.

'Within any identified floodplain area, any new construction shall be prohibited', unless the Township grants a variance. Basements are then prohibited and the lowest floor must be at or above the regulatory flood elevation.
An accessory structure in the identified floodplain area 'shall not be designed or used for human habitation', may have at most 200 sq ft and may have no sanitary facilities.

In the floodplain a permit is needed for any construction or development. No expansion of an existing structure may raise the base flood elevation, and work of 50% or more of its market value must fully meet Chapter 8.
